alerts.title: SBI KYC Update Scam — Nationwide
alerts.description: Fraudsters posing as SBI officials on WhatsApp, sending fake KYC update links that redirect to credential-harvesting pages. Victims report unauthorized transactions after visiting link.

alerts.title: Work-From-Home Job Offer Surge
alerts.description: Fake job offers promising ₹30,000–₹80,000/month for data entry work from home. Targets recent graduates and homemakers. Requires advance registration fee of ₹500–₹2,000.

alerts.title: UPI Collect Request Fraud
alerts.description: Scammers sending UPI collect requests disguised as cashback or refunds. Victims who accept requests unknowingly authorize debit from their account instead of receiving credit.

alerts.title: I4C Impersonation — Digital Arrest Scam
alerts.description: Callers claiming to be I4C or CBI officers threaten 'digital arrest' for alleged illegal online activity. Demand payments of ₹50,000–₹5,00,000 to avoid arrest.

alerts.title: TRAI SIM Card Disconnection Threat
alerts.description: Automated calls claiming TRAI will disconnect SIM cards for illegal activity. Victims are transferred to fake police who demand immediate payment to retain service.

alerts.title: KBC Lottery SMS Wave
alerts.description: Bulk SMS claiming lottery win of ₹25 lakh from KBC. Directs victims to call a number and pay processing fee of ₹2,000–₹10,000 via UPI to claim prize.

alerts.title: AnyDesk RAT Installation Scam
alerts.description: Scammers posing as bank customer support ask victims to install AnyDesk for 'technical assistance'. Once installed, they access the victim's banking app and transfer funds.

alerts.title: Fake Investment Platform Scam
alerts.description: WhatsApp groups promoting fake stock trading and crypto platforms offering guaranteed 3x returns. Initial small returns paid to build trust, then victims lose large deposits.
